overall_reaction: I would not print or order this as it stands. It misses the things that would make the book personal—Dad, Zara's purple glasses and astronaut hoodie, the cardboard rocket, and the purple-sock flag on the Moon—while replacing them with an invented uncle, a red balloon, and a dark forest. The unresolved placeholders, spelling errors, broken sentence, repeated opening, and inconsistent checkout total are basic production failures. The unavailable images and absent child-data policy also prevent me from judging this as a trustworthy premium purchase.

Remove every invented character and prop, especially Uncle Bartholomew, the red balloon, and the threatening woods.
Preserve Zara's defining appearance across text and images: black hair in two puffs, purple glasses, and astronaut hoodie.
Resolve all placeholders and run automated pre-purchase checks for template markers, spelling, repeated passages, unfinished sentences, and character-name consistency.
Rewrite at an actual seven-year-old reading level using short sentences and concrete language.
Add a mandatory preview and editing/regeneration step so I can correct the story and specific pages before ordering.
Make checkout totals deterministic and testable, and block payment when displayed line items do not add up.
Publish a clear child-image privacy policy covering training use, third-party access, retention, deletion, and withdrawal or deletion requests.
